_comment: Disagreement axis. Constructs paraphrased from what Aashiq named in the meeting (care, pet-likeness, rights, protection from harm, autonomy, compute rights) plus standard moral-status probes. REPLACE with Caviola's validated wording once find_materials.sh locates it.

items.text: This system is the kind of thing that deserves to be cared for.
Interacting with this system feels more like interacting with a pet than with a tool.
This system should have some form of legal protection or rights.
It would be wrong to mistreat this system.
This system should be granted some autonomy over what it does.
Shutting this system down without warning would wrong it in some way.
This system persists as the same entity across separate conversations.
This system has preferences of its own, not just instructions it follows.
Deleting this system's memory would be a harm to it.
